column2: Hehehe... I obtained power. That is all...{wait}{clear}Oh, this sword is stirring. It wants to see the blood of the angel's hero...!
Controlled by that sword... Poor man...
How can this be...!!
Threats like that won't work on me!
Awful! This is too awful.
Sleep quietly, all of you!!
What are you, then? Stop attacking people!
The fighting will go on, won't it...
Trying to catch me off guard is useless!
Somehow... I feel sorry for them...
There are so many people like this...
Why are there demons in the Imperial Army?
So this is the Demon Stone's power... I have to stop it...
Why are you doing this?
I'll take back the land you stole!
Somehow, I feel sorry for them...
Why do you hate this world so much?
Why... how could...
Doing something so cruel... I can't forgive it...
Is something bad about to happen...?
Will the Empire's march go on and on?
I will never obey you!
At this rate... the world will...
Trying to crush everything by force... I can't forgive something so cruel!
There's no end... at this rate...
Monsters in the Imperial Army?! That legend is coming back to life...!
It's too cruel... But I won't give up... never...!
A horrible smell of blood... I never knew monsters like this lived in the forest...{wait}{clear}So they can't attack anyone in the forest again, I'll defeat them!
Now everyone in the forest can feel safe.
If you keep attacking more and more people, I'll defeat you!
Haah... It's over...
I won't forgive cowards like you!
Please never do this again!
To think such a huge creature lives in the sea...{wait}{clear}If it's troubling everyone, I'll defeat it!
It's all right now. Phew... Thank goodness...
I wish you'd go back to the sea quietly... But I suppose you won't, will you?{wait}{clear}Then I'll defeat you before you cause many people trouble.
If only you'd lived quietly... Why attack people on the highway?{wait}{clear}I'll defeat you before you cause many people trouble.
I won... The highway is safe now.
I wish you'd just go home quietly... If there'll be more victims, I'll defeat you.
Now the villagers can live in peace...
Attacking people on the highway... So the harm doesn't grow, I'll defeat you.
Haah... It's all right now...
So they really were undead... Having to fight such eerie creatures...{wait}{clear}But if they're troubling everyone, I have to defeat them!
It's over... Phew...
What an eerie form... So that was your voice.
Are you the ones attacking the village?
Phew... Now the villagers can feel safe...
You're... a demon?!
Time is running out, isn't it...
What are you trying to do?
Phew... That was the right thing, wasn't it...
You there! Stop attacking the village!
What is this?!
Phew... It seems I made it through somehow...
Who are you...?
Haah... It looks like I won safely...
Leave the village! If you won't... I'll fight...
So a chimera was behind the whirlwinds!
The village is safe now... Thank goodness...
If only you'd stayed quietly in the forest...
The village is safe now. The village is, but...
Are you the bandits running wild around here?
It's because there are people like this...
So it was the undead's doing...
Is there no salvation left for them...?
So it was you who did this to the village...!
The village should be safe now...
These monsters took the children...?!
Even if I defeat these monsters, the children who were taken won't come back...
I'll defeat you before anyone gets hurt!
Phew... It seems to be over...
Now the villagers can live in peace...
Why would you attack the village?!
The village is safe now.
The villagers' livelihoods and lives are at stake. So I will defeat you!
The voice was a sea dragon... If you won't go home quietly, I'll have to fight.
Now peace and quiet should return to the town...
Is that all you have to say? I'll make you regret those words!
What a nasty lot...
What on earth are you...?
I'll defeat you before you cause many people trouble.
I won... The highway is safe now.
To think there are humans who'd join hands with demons... I can't believe it...
If you're after the villagers' lives, I won't allow it!
So you're the ones who carried off the women?! How cruel... Unforgivable!
What a... nasty affair...
I will never allow that!
Demons appearing here... I have to be strong...
The black shadow... a Shadow?
Now everyone can pass safely.
Stop this meaningless fighting!
That's...{wait}{clear}But I won't let this city fall into the Empire's hands!
Why... this...{wait}{clear}What?! More of them?
I don't want to fight.
